mapper.sql: menu_id, parent_id, menu_name, path, component, menu_type, icon, order_num, status
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.status FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = '0' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

FROM sys_menu WHERE status = '0' ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
SELECT role_id, role_name, role_key, status FROM sys_role WHERE status = '0' ORDER BY role_id
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_key = 'admin'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, menu_name, path, component, menu_type, icon, order_num, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{path}, #{component}, #{menuType}, #{icon}, #{orderNum}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, path = #{path}, component = #{component}, menu_type = #{menuType}, icon = #{icon}, order_num = #{orderNum}, status = #{status} WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
